paper.title: DESI 2024 VI: Cosmological Constraints from the Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations
truncated_sections: Appendix A Comparison of results from DESI and combined DESI+SDSS BAO data
Appendix B Comparison to Planck PR4 likelihoods

result.summary: 本文报告了DESI第一年观测（DR1）中星系、类星体和莱曼α森林示踪物测量的重子声学振荡（BAO）宇宙学结果，在0.1<z<4.2的七个红移区间内提供了相对于声视界的横向共动距离和哈勃率的稳健测量 [abstract]。DESI BAO数据单独与平坦ΛCDM模型一致，给出物质密度Ωm=0.295±0.015 [abstract]。结合BBN先验和CMB声学角尺度，DESI要求H0=(68.52±0.62) km/s/Mpc [abstract]。在扩展模型中，DESI与CMB或Ia型超新星组合偏好w0>-1和wa<0，与ΛCDM的差异在2.5σ至3.9σ之间 [abstract]。这些结果展示了DESI在暗能量和宇宙学参数测量上的强大能力 [S8.p9]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在利用DESI第一年观测的BAO测量，在多个红移区间内约束宇宙学参数，并检验标准ΛCDM模型及扩展模型 [S1.p8]。研究动机在于暗能量动力学尚未被严格检验，且ΛCDM模型内存在哈勃张力等统计显著的不一致，可能指示新物理 [S1.p3]。DESI作为Stage IV巡天，设计用于通过测量星系、类星体和莱曼α森林的成团性显著改善宇宙学约束 [S1.p7]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we report the constraints derived from the measurements of baryon acoustic oscillations with the first year of data from DESI as part of a larger series of papers.
However, dark energy dynamics has not been stringently tested.
Such tensions, if not due to unaccounted systematics, may indicate new physics beyond $\Lambda$ CDM.

The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) is carrying out a Stage IV survey that was designed to significantly improve cosmological constraints through measurements of the clustering of galaxies, quasars, and the Lyman- $\alpha$ forest.

method.text: 论文采用BAO标准尺方法，通过测量星系、类星体和莱曼α森林示踪物的两点关联函数来约束D_M/r_d、D_H/r_d或D_V/r_d [S2.SS3.p1][S2.SS3.p7]。为减轻确认偏差，实施了盲分析，在系统误差调查和管线最终确定前隐藏真实宇宙学结果 [S2.SS3.SSS1.p2]。使用cobaya进行贝叶斯推断，结合CAMB计算理论宇宙学，并采用MCMC采样 [S2.SS5.p1][S2.SS5.p2][S2.SS5.p3]。

evidence.quote: We now briefly describe how DESI BAO analyses of DR1 data implement the standard ruler measurement.
For all other tracers, we quote results in $D_{\mathrm{M}}/r_{\mathrm{d}}$ and $D_{\mathrm{H}}/r_{\mathrm{d}}$, and provide the value of the correlation between them, $r$.

To mitigate against the possibility of such biases unknowingly entering into our analyses, we apply a system of blinding our data, to conceal the true cosmological results during the period where systematic errors were being investigated and analysis pipelines finalised.
We included in the cosmological inference code cobaya the PantheonPlus, Union3 and DESY5 SN Ia likelihoods, as well as our new DESI BAO likelihoods.
When running cobaya, we rely on the Boltzmann code CAMB for theoretical cosmology calculations.
All Bayesian inference is performed using the Metropolis-Hastings MCMC sampler in cobaya.

experiments.text: 分析使用了DESI DR1中超过600万个独特红移的星系、类星体和莱曼α森林样本，覆盖0.1<z<4.2的七个红移区间 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS3.SSS2.p1]。外部数据集包括BBN先验、Planck和ACT的CMB数据以及三个Ia型超新星数据集（Pantheon+、Union3、DES-SN5YR） [S2.SS4.SSS1.p3][S2.SS4.SSS2.p4][S2.SS4.SSS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: Overall, this analysis of the DESI Data Release 1 relies on over $6$ million unique redshifts, more than twice the number of redshifts considered in the final SDSS cosmological analysis.

The results used in this paper are derived from the BAO measurements and fits described above applied to each of the five tracer samples across 7 distinct redshift bins covering a total redshift range from 0.1 to 4.2.
We adopt these values as BBN priors in the following sections.
We adopt this combined CMB lensing likelihood from both experiments as our baseline.
In this paper, we make use of three different SN Ia datasets.

findings.text: DESI BAO数据单独与平坦ΛCDM一致，给出Ωm=0.295±0.015和r_d h=(101.8±1.3) Mpc [S4.SS1.p1]。结合BBN和θ*先验，H0=(68.52±0.62) km/s/Mpc [S4.SS1.p4]。在w CDM模型中，DESI BAO单独给出w=-0.99^{+0.15}_{-0.13} [S5.SS1.p3]。在w0wa CDM模型中，DESI+CMB+SN Ia组合偏好w0>-1和wa<0，与ΛCDM的差异在2.5σ、3.5σ和3.9σ水平 [S5.SS2.p5]。DESI BAO+CMB给出中微子质量总和上限∑mν<0.072 eV (95% CL) [S7.SS1.p5]。

evidence.quote: The 68% credible-interval results for these parameters are $\left.\begin{aligned} \Omega_{\mathrm{m}}&=0.295\pm 0.015,\\ r_{\mathrm{d}}h&=(101.8\pm 1.3)\,\text{Mpc},\end{aligned}\ \right\}\ \ \mbox{\text{\parbox{42.67912pt}{\begin{flushleft}DESI~BAO, \end{flushleft}}}}$ (15)
in combination with BBN information, further tightens the $H_{0}$ result to $H_{0}=(68.52\pm 0.62)\;\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}\qquad(\mbox{DESI BAO\,+\,BBN\,+\,$\theta_{\ast}$}),$ (19)

We find $\left.\begin{aligned} \Omega_{\mathrm{m}}&=0.293\pm 0.015,\\ w&=-0.99^{+0.15}_{-0.13},\end{aligned}\ \right\}\ \ \mbox{\text{\parbox{42.67912pt}{\begin{flushleft}DESI~BAO, \end{flushleft}}}}$ (25)
These correspond to preferences for a $w_{0}w_{a}$ CDM model over $\Lambda$ CDM model at the $2.5\sigma$, $3.5\sigma$ and $3.9\sigma$ significance levels, respectively.

while adding the DESI BAO data sharply reduces this to $\left.\sum m_{\nu}<0.072{\,\rm eV}\quad\mbox{\text{\parbox{113.81102pt}{\begin{flushleft}(95\,\%,~DESI~BAO+CMB). \end{flushleft}}}}\right.$ (40)

limitations.text: 作者指出，中微子质量上限强烈依赖于∑mν的先验选择，且在扩展暗能量模型中显著放宽 [S7.SS1.p7][S7.SS1.p9]。w0wa CDM的偏好可能被过度解释，因为部分偏好模型可映射到不违反零能量条件的精质模型 [S5.SS2.p9]。DESI与SDSS在0.6<z<0.8红移区间的BAO测量存在约3σ差异，原因尚不清楚，可能是样本方差涨落 [S3.SS3.p4][S3.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: We also caution that the upper bound obtained is strongly dependent on the choice of prior for $\sum m_{\nu}$.
However, we repeat the caveat that the limits are substantially relaxed in more extended dark energy models that affect the background geometry, such as those in Section 5.

However, we caution against over-interpretation of this result, since at least some of the $\left(w_{0},w_{a}\right)$ models preferred by our analysis could be mapped to quintessence models which reproduce the observable quantities $D_{M}/r_{d}$ and $D_{H}/r_{d}$ to high precision even though they do not violate the null energy condition at any redshift (e.g., see), and such an effective equation of state can also be obtained from models with modified gravity or multiple fields.
the discrepancy between the DESI and SDSS results in the $0.6<z<0.8$ redshift range is at roughly the $\sim 3\sigma$ level.
The cause of this difference is not clear.

The cause of the difference may simply an unlucky sample variance fluctuation—if so, this will soon become clear with later DESI data releases, which will have a much larger $V_{\rm eff}$ in this redshift range.
